items.html:
Like a fair number of team-mates in the Under-19 World Cup in New Zealand, Kaleem Sana has had first-class experience. He made his debut for Pakistan Customs in 2009 and has played two games, grabbing three wickets.
Cricinfo Staff, January 2010
